name: Banh ep Cau Hai
summary: A pressed cake from the Cầu Hai lagoon in Phú Lộc. CafeBiz, Phùng Hà, 29 June 2022, says tapioca starch, lean pork, and shrimp, eaten hot with mắm nêm. Đại Việt Tourist does not agree. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Đầm Cầu Hai, Phú Lộc, under Bạch Mã. CafeBiz, 29 June 2022, places the cake there, about 45 km south of Huế.
texture: CafeBiz says the cake is about the size of an adult palm, hot off the mold, and chewy. Đại Việt Tourist, 19 April 2025, calls it a thin crisp cake. Both stay.
taste: CafeBiz says the dip is mắm nêm with garlic and chili, and that bánh ép Thuận An uses fatty pork, egg, and a sweet-sour dip instead. Đại Việt Tourist, 15 August 2024, also says mắm nêm. The 19 April 2025 account says nước mắm with garlic and chili. Both dips stay.
howToEat: CafeBiz says eat it hot. Roll it like bánh cuốn with lettuce, cucumber, split water spinach, banana blossom, herbs, and bean sprouts, and dip it in mắm nêm.

Đại Việt Tourist, 15 August 2024, says the filling is pork, rolled with cucumber, lettuce, and rau răm, and dipped in mắm nêm. Shrimp is not in that account. The 19 April 2025 account says pork and nước mắm. Do not pick one filling or one dip.
A price is Check on arrival. An hour is Check on arrival.
where: Phú Lộc, at the Cầu Hai lagoon. CafeBiz does not print a stall at chợ Cầu Hai. A price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh ep Cau Hai — two fillings, two dips
seoDescription: Bánh ép Cầu Hai is a lagoon cake in Phú Lộc. CafeBiz says pork, shrimp, and mắm nêm. Đại Việt Tourist disagrees. A price is Check on arrival.
